method: UE FRotator quaternion formula; transformed box-corner union against original PostCleaningAttackInfo.Bounds. .001cm is numerical comparison tolerance, not gameplay tuning.

conclusions.size: Box Size is half-extents, supported by reconstructed source bounds (see per-window matches).
conclusions.baked_center: LocalCenterPos is attachment-origin transform. It must be composed with RelativeOffset and AbsoluteOffset to obtain collision center.
conclusions.rotation: RelativeRotatoion composition is derived per-window by original bounds comparison; use best_model only when it matches.
conclusions.local_reference_frame: Original native local-frame origin still unverified. Derived keys remain source-local, not confirmed current capsule-center actor-local.
conclusions.cylinder: Box evidence does not prove Cylinder fields/height conventions.
